(Hemant Sen Vs The State Of Madhya Prades
 Dated : 10-01-2025
 Shri Satyam Agrawal - Advocate for appellant.

Shri Geetesh Singh Thakur - Government 
 respondent/State.
Per Justice Smt. Anuradha Shukla.

Heard on I.A.No.15502/2023, which is first application filed under Section 389(1) of the Code of
Criminal Procedure 1973, for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail on behalf of sole appellant
- Hemant Sen.

The appellant has been convicted for the offence punishable under Section 366 of IPC and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 5 years with fine of Rs.3,000/-, Section 5(l)/6 of POCSO Act, 2012 and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 20 years with fine of Rs.7,000/- respectively, with default stipulations.

He has also been convicted under Sections 376(2)(n) and 366 of IPC, but no separate sentence has been awarded vide judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 13.06.2023 passed by First Additional Sessions Judge, Ashta, District Sehore, in S.C. No.61/2020.

entities.text: First Additional Sessions Judge, Ashta, District Sehore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the matter.
He also submits that the trial Court has not properly appreciated the oral and documentary evidence available on record and committed error in convicting the appellant for aforesaid offence.

It has been argued that the age of prosecutrix has not been 2 CRA-8349-2023 proved convincingly in this case and merely on the entry in scholar register the date of birth cannot be considered as proved.

It has also been submitted that according to father of prosecutrix he was married in 1993 and prosecutrix was born 8 years after his marriage, therefore, her year of birth comes to 2001 while in school record this entry is of the year 2005.
The appeal would take considerable time to conclude.
He is ready to furnish adequate surety and shall abide by the directions and conditions, which may be imposed by this Court.
Hence, it is prayed that the application for suspension of sentence may be considered.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the State has opposed the application and prays for its rejection.
Heard counsel for the parties and perused the record.

Having heard the arguments and on perusal of the record, we are of the considered opinion that till disposal of this appeal, execution of jail sentences awarded to the appellant under the impugned judgment deserve to be suspended.
Therefore, without commenting on the merit of the case, this application is allowed.

It is directed that subject to depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned, the custodial sentence of the appellant shall remain suspended and he shall be released on bail for securing his presence before the trial Court concerned on 15.04.2025 and on such other dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of this appeal.
3 CRA-8349-2023
Accordingly, the aforesaid I.A. stands allowed and disposed of.
List for final hearing in due course.

(SUSHRUT ARVIND DHARMADHIKARI) (ANURADHA SHU  JUDGE JUDGE  rv Hemant Sen vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/70137357/
